neighbours.label: the token ' opaque' (mostly its physical sense: paint, glass, layers that block light)
fire: Keep adding coats of white until the wall looks fully opaque.
The bottle is made of opaque plastic so sunlight cannot spoil the milk.
Thin watercolor washes stay transparent, but gouache dries opaque.
The bathroom window uses opaque glass for privacy.
Mix a little titanium white into the glaze to make it more opaque.
The lens turned opaque after years of exposure to the sun.
Choose an opaque fabric for the curtains in the bedroom.
The ink is so opaque that it covers dark paper in one pass.
quiet: Keep adding coats of white until the wall looks fully even.
The bottle is made of thick plastic so sunlight cannot spoil the milk.
Thin watercolor washes stay transparent, but gouache dries flat.
The bathroom window uses textured glass for privacy.
Mix a little titanium white into the glaze to make it more pale.
The lens turned yellow after years of exposure to the sun.
Choose a heavy fabric for the curtains in the bedroom.
The ink is so dense that it covers dark paper in one pass.
